summary: Creates a new skill for harmonizing clinical panel data from JSON sources, which differs significantly from the existing CSV-centric skill. The trace revealed JSON-specific challenges (nested structures, status filtering for draft vs final records) and blood gas unit conversions (kPa↔mmHg) not covered in the CSV skill. The failure likely stems from CRLF line endings (\r\n) and potential unit conversion errors. The new skill captures the JSON flattening workflow, bidirectional unit testing for respiratory/metabolic analytes, and critical formatting requirements including Unix line endings.
